extName.message: Show Video Controls by Default for Firefox
extName.description: Extension name shown in the Firefox Add-ons listing. The Chromium build replaces it (see scripts/build-chromium.mjs).

extDescription.message: Automatically turns on the browser's native controls for HTML5 videos, so you never right-click "Show Controls" again.
extDescription.description: Short summary shown in the store listing and the extensions page. Chrome limits it to 132 characters.
